executive_summary.text: Cost year 2025: dietary cost per resident day ($54.06) was 183% of the Connecticut median ($29.51). Ask what drove the higher dietary cost (contracts, supplies, staffing or a one-time expense).
Cost year 2025: direct care cost was $244.57 per resident day (46.3% of expenses); Connecticut median $174.45.
Cost year 2025: nursing home operating margin was -13.0% (Connecticut median 2.5%).
Cost year 2025: nursing pool (agency) staff counted in direct care cost $141,483, 0.9% of the $15,664,272 direct care cost.

Cost year 2025: dietary cost $3,462,615, $54.06 per resident day (Connecticut median $29.51). Wages $1,122,126 (32.4%), allocated fringe $361,757 (10.4%), non-wage costs $1,978,732 (57.1%). Most food spending was a purchased (contracted) service ($953,415), so raw food per resident day is not comparable with homes that buy their own food.
Cost year 2025: housekeeping cost $1,355,519, $21.16 per resident day (Connecticut median $12.32). Wages $921,316 (68.0%), allocated fringe $297,019 (21.9%), non-wage costs $137,184 (10.1%).
Missing data: Cost year 2025 raw food is not used: not comparable (food bought by a contractor, lines do not add up, or missing).

definitions.wages_reported: Salaries and wages printed on the cost report for that department. Not total department spending.
definitions.total_department_cost: Wages + allocated fringe + non-salary costs for the department, as computed by the site's cost-report build.
definitions.direct_care: DSS rate-setting definition: nursing and aide salaries, related fringe (allocated), and nursing pool (agency) cost.
definitions.figures: As filed by the home before DSS audit. Not Medicaid-allowable costs.
definitions.data_quality: Per year: status validated (core figures present, payer days add up, nothing out of range), unvalidated (read, but printed totals did not fully reconcile: treat as provisional) or check_failed (core figures missing or implausible: not used in reports). unusable_fields lists figures in that year that should not be quoted, with the reason.
definitions.raw_food_per_resident_day: Raw food cost / resident days. Only shown when the home buys its own food; when a contractor supplies meals the raw-food line is not comparable.
